gap.behavioural_impact: Stat erratum, not an effect change: the original MFC-060 printing had 1300 ATK and DR1-EN115 corrected it to 1500 ATK - the lineage's raw entries show ATK/1300 deleted and ATK/1500 inserted while the effect text is word-for-word unchanged between v0 and v1. Upstream carries the difference in card data only: cards-unofficial.cdb 511006010 is ATK 1300 / DEF 1300 against cards.cdb 55821894 at ATK 1500 / DEF 1300, and pre-errata/c511006010.lua is behaviourally identical to official/c55821894.lua (single EFFECT_AVOID_BATTLE_DAMAGE effect; the packet's script diff is empty and the files differ only by a name comment).

review.notes: The 1500-ATK correction (DR1-EN115, 2005-03-19) predates the GOAT snapshot (2005-04-01) by thirteen days and Edison (2010-04-24) by five years, so neither period format wants the 1300-ATK version; the record exists so that boundary is explicit and machine-checkable rather than assumed. Conflicting evidence: upstream's 'Pre-Errata' entry carries the MODERN effect wording ('You take no battle damage from attacks involving this card', lineage v3 / LCJW-EN088) rather than the period MFC/DR1 wording, so only its ATK is period-accurate - do not treat its cdb text as period display text. Trailing text revisions v1 -> v2 (GLD3-EN005, 2010-06-18) -> v3 (LCJW-EN088, 2013-10-11) are cosmetic ('All Battle Damage to this card's controller that he/she takes from a battle involving this monster becomes 0' -> 'You take no battle damage from attacks involving this card'), same resolution, and are not recorded as changes.

effective.basis: TCG release of Dark Revelation Volume 1 (DR1-EN115), the first printing carrying the corrected 1500 ATK
